# Tips for the daily and weekly challenges

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_21_nukaknights-post-tipps-challenges.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The challenges for the daily and weekly challenges are repeated very often. Before the "legendary race" (game board / season), the challenges were repeated in a similar form, now it has become a little easier.

**Every day at 6 p.m.** (during the time change at 5 p.m.) the challenges are reset. On Tuesday both the daily and weekly ones.

But there are some things that people are always looking for, so here is a short list from us:

**Recycle Scrap to Gain Crystal**

The easiest and fastest way to complete this challenge is to buy in bulk. Large quantities of crystal shards are available from dealers in the Whitespring Mall (it's not always the same) for around 280 crown caps per large quantity.

Alternatively, you can e.g. Collect and recycle the following scrap items on the Clancy estate:

- Broken cameras
- Magnifying glasses
-Crystal decanter
- Microscopes
- Crystal Shards

These items can also be purchased from some bots, for example the Whitespring Station Bot has crystal decanters.

**Sell Wolf Ribs / Kill a Wolf**

You can find wolves here:

- Autumn field hat
- Investigator's hat
- Widow's Perch

Events:

-Free range
-Lead Wolf
-Tea time

**Collect pre-war food**

To do this, equip the perk “Happiness in Cans” under Luck (preferably at 3). Now go to Watoga or Whitespring and look in every container (trash can, etc.). All canned and packaged foods are pre-war foods. Examples:

- Dog food
- canned coffee
- Imitation seafood
- Rice a la Canjun
-Cram
- Chewing gum
-Chewy candy
- etc.

**Take a photo of a Sheepsquatch with your camera**

A sheepsquatch is now hard to find outside of events, so it's not worth looking for. Look out for these events:

-Free range
-Project Paradise
-The wheel

Whether the sheepsquatch in the photo is dead or alive is not important.

**Cripple the head/arms/legs of a Deathclaw/Sentry Bot (with an energy weapon)**

This challenge can appear in different variations or be rolled, but is easily solved. The tips are basically the same as in the article Tip: Guaranteed to force Queen (and firebeasts) to land.

- Weapon: best shotgun (cold shoulder or with energy weapon: Gauss shotgun)
- Perk: Equip "Emphatically" under Agility (preferably at 3)
- Perk: "Concentrated Fire" extends to 1
- Activate VATS before the opponent
- Set VATS to the desired body part (arm/leg/head), the bar on the body part in VATS shows the condition. If this is empty, the body part is crippled.
- Shoot

With shotguns this usually works on the first try. With rifles you need the perk "Tormentor" (luck) and with heavy weapons you need the perk "One Weapon Army" (luck).

**Kill/Photograph a RAD Scorpion**

- 4 RAD Scorpions are guaranteed to spawn at Smith Farm in Toxic Valley
- Possible spawn also at the Kiddie Corner huts in Toxic Valley
- Possible spawn at the middle mountain huts (Savage Divide)
- Possible spawn at the Freak Show (Savage Divide)
- Possible spawn also during events like "Scorched Earth" or some others

**Kill animals with an improvised weapon**

- Weapons: Improv Revolver, Improv Rifle, Improv Pistol, Improv Repeater
- Ultracite titanium
- Chickens
- Mixed races
-Cats
-Dogs
- Incendiary beasts
- Frogs
- Owls
- Bieber
-Possum
-Squirrel
- RAD advice
-Rabbit
- Wolves
-Yao Guai
- Brahmin
- Mole rats
- Mega sloth
-R
